existing_fulltext_validation.scope: All currently archived broad DTU files checked; defective/partial files do not count as full-text eligibility assessment. Not closure of all search scenarios

base_dt.status: Title/abstract only; full-text eligibility not inferred. Original records and source variants preserved.

rules: Metadata lookup failure is not proof that report retrieval was attempted.
Not-retrieved reports are distinct from full-text exclusions.
Do not transfer uncertainty-based exclusions to DT-only eligibility.
Old numerical verification does not establish new full-text semantic verification.

updated_fulltext_validation.scope: Current versioned reconciliation; no inference that all candidates have been assessed or are irretrievable.
